Game Overview

In Stunt Witch, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a high-flying adventure as a daring Stunt Witch. Maneuver through hoops, dodge hazards, and collect stars while managing your fuel. Each level's increasing difficulty demands sharp reflexes and strategic planning. Get ready for a visually vibrant and magical test of endurance and agility!
